claims.explanation: Table 1 and E01 fix ViT-B/16-IN1K, frozen backbone, no rehearsal and the named CIL splits. One best-baseline property compares SEMA against FT Adapter, L2P, DualPrompt, CODA-P, SimpleCIL, ADAM and InfLoRA at all six dataset/split coordinates, with ge preserving the allowed equality. AN is bound to the table's explicitly labelled final average accuracy, not the adjacent average-incremental Ā columns. The 91.37% in the falsifier identifies the reported SEMA CIFAR-100 measurement rather than a new stand-alone threshold; that measurement is read from evidence, never copied into the spec. No exceptional dataset or baseline is dropped.

E02 requires sub-linear growth over ImageNet-A tasks versus linear CODA-P/DualPrompt plus fewer final parameters at equivalent or better accuracy than Expansion by Task. Figure fig8_param_growth.md has approximate sparse parameter readings (including a range at task 10), while Table 5 has final parameter/accuracy pairs. Reported catalog comparisons cannot express a sub-linear versus linear curve-shape assertion; endpoint ratios or lower final parameter counts would omit it. Table 5 additionally labels its accuracy as AN while its values coincide with Table 1's Ā column, so those metric identities are not silently reconciled. No partial efficiency-only declaration discharges C02.

Table 2 and E03 compare the full z-score-triggered, learned-soft-router SEMA with precisely No Exp., Avg. W., Rand. W., Top-1 Sel., and Rand. Sel. on ImageNet-A and VTAB under the frozen IN1K no-rehearsal setup. Two conjunctive best-baseline properties preserve both AN and Ā, the two performance metrics named in the experiment and falsifier. Top-1 Sel. Inf. is excluded because inference-only hard selection is a distinct sixth ablation not named by C03; no aliases merge it with Top-1 Sel. The Statement's per-dataset superiority is retained rather than weakened to merely not losing both metrics on both datasets simultaneously.

Table 3 has AN and Ā for default Adapter [9], LoRA [30] and Convpass [34] on both ImageNet-A and VTAB. C04's substantive within-2%-AN condition is an additive accuracy margin (its falsifier specifically prohibits a drop exceeding two percentage points), not an ordering or a 0.98 ratio. The reported relations have no standalone additive-margin/equivalence comparison; compound_consistency's tolerance applies only alongside an additional required comparison scope, which this claim does not supply. The catalog's generative equivalence relation requires paired fresh runs and introduces a confidence commitment, so it is not substituted for these fixed reported measurements.
